info.title: Web Page to Markdown: URL to LLM-Ready Text
info.description:
Turn any web page URL into clean, LLM-ready Markdown with title, description, language and canonical URL. Plain HTTP, no browser, so it is fast and cheap for RAG and AI agents.

Runs on your own Apify account (pay-per-use). Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/url-to-markdown
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=publicrecords/url-to-markdown
Author: Public Records.
